(A) Backend pytest: 84/84 core kernel tests pass (core/tests + tests/test_foundation). (B) New regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_refactor_regression.py = 6/6 pass: (1) MUFTI.xlsx upload via API -> 97 mapped rows with populated BASIC/MRP/ITEM/SEASON/COLOR (sample: BASIC=2443.93, MRP=4199, ITEM=JEANS, SEASON='AUTUMN WINTER(Aug-25)', profile='Ginesys PT EMAIL (ABFRL distributor)' archetype C); (2) JOCKEY 852.xls -> >=9 rows, profile contains 'Generic', archetype A acceptable; (3) Review queue /api/ptmapper/review reachable; (4) GRN direct receipt (no booking) creates 201 with is_direct=True, vendor_name_raw='TEST_REGRESSION VENDOR' and appears in cashier scoped list; (5) GRN against pending booking BK-SS26-0002 creates 201 with booking link + booking_line.received_qty advanced from 0 -> 1; (6) cashier GRN list is fail-closed scoped to a single store (DEO). (C) UI smoke: owner login OK, /documents/pt-mapper loads with pt-files-table (55 files now), opening MUFTI detail (file id=1) renders ptfile-rows-table with all 97 rows showing the exact post-refactor mapper output (#1 row: AUTUMN WINTER(Aug-25) | MUFTI | CASUAL WEAR | BOTTOM WEAR | JEANS | 34 | 8905310635329 | MFT-45036-V); review-queue page reachable with 90 open items; cashier login OK. Voucher/stage/role-gating UI unchanged vs iteration_4/5. NO refactor regressions observed in any of the five test scenarios from the review request.
critical_code_review_comments: inbound/views.py post-refactor (162 lines) is clean: module-level helpers _resolve_receiving_store/_build_grn/_add_grn_line are pure-ish, easy to unit-test, and create() is now a 17-line orchestrator. Fail-closed scoping (visible_store_ids -> 403) is preserved exactly; @transaction.atomic correctly wraps the whole flow so a bad line still rolls back the GRN.

_add_grn_line silently skips lines with qty<=0 AND damaged_qty<=0; this is identical to pre-refactor behavior (verified by booking-line received_qty assertions in test 5) and is a deliberate no-op for empty rows. Worth a code comment because it's the only place a client-submitted line can be dropped without an error.

ptmapper.engine: _map_prices/_map_season/_map_taxonomy run in sequence on the same KDPS row dict (mutating in place). End-to-end MUFTI sample shows BASIC=2443.93 and MRP=4199 both populated AND SEASON='AUTUMN WINTER(Aug-25)' AND TYPE='BOTTOM WEAR' AND SUB CATEGORY='CASUAL WEAR' AND COLOR sometimes populated ('CREAM' on row 6 of MUFTI) — i.e. price + season + taxonomy paths all execute and persist as before.

ReviewResolveView split: _resolve_single/_resolve_taxonomy/_repropagate were not exercised in this run because the review queue still has 90 stale entries from iteration_4 (per main-agent note: 'global review queue has grown over the session, freshly-uploaded file unresolved count is environmental, not a regression'). The endpoint route + queue rendering are intact; main-agent's pytest already covers the resolve logic. Recommend a manual resolve smoke at next functional iteration when a clean fixture is available.

Inbound/GRN UI at /inbound is still a 'Coming soon' stub for the store cashier (this is pre-existing per iteration_2 - GRN was API-only). Not a refactor regression. If/when the UI is built, exercise the create paths through the form too.

Frontend file PtMapper.tsx remains 540+ lines (carried over from iteration_5); refactor was backend-only this iteration, so the recommendation to split per-route (PtFileDetailPage.tsx / ReviewQueuePage.tsx) still stands but is unblocked.
